summary: Third-party executable Provider plugin hrhrng.hub for the overseas MiniMax Hub media catalog.
context_hints: The plugin id is hrhrng.hub and its Provider declaration is providers/hilo-hub.json
Plugin code performs native upstream HTTP and uses only the Host-selected account state exposed through context.store
MiniMax H3 and Seedance references are uploaded through /api/v1/files/upload before submission
At the upload boundary, normalize audio/mpeg to audio/mp3 because Hub derives the file extension from the data-URI media type

subdirectories.providers: Hilo Hub Provider declaration and supported sign-in methods.
subdirectories.bindings: Provider-specific model routes, parameter overrides, defaults, and exclusions.
subdirectories.src: Typed stdio entrypoint, native Hub adapter, executor, upload adaptation, and tests.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned executable package and contributed Provider, bindings, and executor.
key_files.providers/hilo-hub.json: Provider metadata, account flows, executor link, and binding defaults.
key_files.src/hub-adapter.ts: Hub request and response shape translation.
key_files.src/hub-executor.ts: Native Hub HTTP execution, reference upload, MIME adaptation, and polling.
